title: Catalogue product shot: stoneware teapot
prompt: High-end catalogue product photograph of a speckled cream stoneware teapot with a bamboo handle on a seamless warm-white paper sweep; one large softbox from the left giving a single soft wrap-around shadow, subtle glaze reflections, true colours, crisp edges, 90 mm lens, f/8. why: Everything a product photographer would set is in the prompt: one softbox, its direction, the shadow it makes, the lens and the aperture. Models respond to that vocabulary far better than to 'professional product photo'.

title: Editorial studio portrait, real skin
prompt: Editorial studio portrait of a woman in her mid-forties with deep brown skin and short natural hair streaked with grey, wearing a charcoal merino turtleneck, calm direct gaze with the hint of a smile. 85 mm lens at f/4, one large octabox key light from camera left with a soft silver fill, neutral mid-grey seamless backdrop, true-to-life skin with visible pores and fine lines, no retouched plastic look, muted palette of charcoal, grey and warm brown. Head and shoulders in the upper two thirds of a vertical frame.
why: 'Visible pores and fine lines, no retouched plastic look' is the line that fights the smooth-skin default. Lens, aperture, one key light and a fill give the model a concrete lighting diagram.

title: Golden-hour field portrait
prompt: Outdoor editorial portrait of a South Asian man in his early thirties with a short dark beard and wavy hair, wearing an open-collar oatmeal linen shirt, standing in a ripe wheat field at golden hour. 135 mm lens at f/2, low sun behind him lighting the edge of the hair and beard, a soft reflector fill on the face, gentle lens flare, creamy out-of-focus field, warm honey and ochre palette, natural skin texture with no smoothing. why: Backlight plus a named reflector fill is how the face stays readable against the sun. The palette is written out (honey, ochre) so the grade is consistent across re-runs.

title: Neon night portrait, anamorphic
prompt: Cinematic night portrait of a Latino man in his mid-twenties with dark curly hair, a small silver hoop earring and a dark green bomber jacket, standing on a rain-wet street lit by shop signs. 50 mm anamorphic lens at f/1.8, cyan rim light on one side and magenta on the other, soft practical light on the face, rain droplets on the jacket, bokeh of blurred signs behind, teal-and-magenta film grade with natural skin texture preserved. title: Edit: enhance a dim phone photo, change nothing else
prompt: Enhance this photo: sharpen soft detail, reduce noise and grain, and balance the exposure so the face is clearly lit. Keep the man, his expression, the colors and the composition exactly as they are. Make it look like the same photo taken with a much better camera, natural and not over-processed, no plastic skin, no oversharpening halos. Do not change the framing, crop, camera angle, or anything not mentioned. The result must look like an untouched real photograph, with no smudges, repeated textures, halos or visible seams.
why: An editing prompt is mostly a list of what must not change. Naming 'no plastic skin, no oversharpening halos' sets the failure modes the model should avoid in its own words.

title: Edit: selfie to business headshot, keep the face
prompt: Turn this selfie into a professional business headshot: a dark navy blazer over a white top, soft studio lighting, a plain dark teal seamless background, sharp focus. Keep the face, features, skin tone, hair, expression and identity exactly as they are. Professional headshot quality: the look of an 85 mm lens at f/2.8, one large soft key light with a gentle fill and a subtle rim, clean catchlights, natural skin texture with no plastic smoothing, crisp focus on the eyes, well-fitted clothes. Do not change the framing, crop, camera angle, or anything not mentioned. The result must look like an untouched real photograph, with no smudges, repeated textures, halos or visible seams.
why: Wardrobe, background and light are changed; face, hair, skin tone and expression are locked. The 85 mm, f/2.8, key-fill-rim description makes 'professional' concrete.

title: Beauty portrait, freckles kept
